Question-scoped CR-endpoint layer for question.json, not a targetable_features screen. Every remission figure is labelled CR, CRi, CRh, MLFS or composite with its denominator, and rows from populations she is excluded from say so. New CR-specific evidence the source dossier did not carry: Giles second-salvage CR 13% of 594 with risk-group rates 54/26/8/0%; CPX-351+venetoclax splitting true CR 15% from CRc 39% and CRc 70% in first-salvage TP53-wild-type against 26% in second-salvage or TP53-mutated; MIRROS control-arm true CR 17.1% of 123 as the randomised R/R benchmark; Alwash on acquired TP53 (composite CR/CRi 41% below 20% VAF vs 13% at or above, 36% of post-HCT patients acquiring TP53); Daver frontline TP53 meta-analysis where CR/CRi hides a true-CR gap (43% IC vs 33% VEN-HMA); Araki on MRD-positive CR performing like active disease before transplant, with Lv 2025 pulling the other way on chasing MRD-negativity; Padmanabhan myeloid-sarcoma meta-analysis (56% marrow/sarcoma molecular discordance, 46% isolated extramedullary post-transplant relapse). Six rows carried from the reference-verified source dossier aml-mds-related-rr-tp53-aberrant-hla-pending-x7q2-rerun2 (lintuzumab-Ac225, MyloFrance-1, SIERRA, FLAMSA, pivekimab, flotetuzumab) with extraction re-checked against the primary abstracts and re-framed on the CR-versus-composite axis. Question-scoped CR-induction mechanism layer for question.json, not a targetable_features screen: question.json is the scope spine and puts standard salvage regimens in scope on equal terms, so the usual feature-filter step was replaced by the question's in_scope list. The 33-row source dossier (aml-mds-related-rr-tp53-aberrant-hla-pending-x7q2-rerun2) was cited, not redone - HA-1/HA-2 and WT1/PRAME/CG1 TCR platforms, CD33/CD123 antigen-density biology, TP53 reactivators, GvL/HLA-class-II-loss immunobiology, MCL1/monocytic venetoclax resistance and myeloid-sarcoma clonal-divergence biology are all carried there. Seven layers built here: CPX-351 fixed-ratio pharmacology (Tardi/Lim/Kim/Wang), cladribine ara-CTP modulation behind CLAG backbones (Gandhi), 225Ac-CD33 alpha therapy including reversal of venetoclax resistance (Garg/Srideshikan/McDevitt), gemtuzumab CD33 saturation kinetics (van der Velden), E-selectin niche chemoresistance for uproleselan (Barbier), blast-burden niche mechanisms split into drug-response (Passaro/Duarte/Ishikawa) and count-recovery (Waclawiczek/Boyd/Hooper) arms, and clonal-selection/apoptotic-priming biology for second salvage, venetoclax refractoriness and TP53 (Farge/Ding/Vo/Moujalled/Bhatt/Wong/Boettcher), plus MECOM (Masamoto) and a p53-bypass differentiation option (Biswas). Two honest empties recorded rather than stretched: no preclinical model reports remission-induction rates for a myeloid sarcoma against any candidate regimen (nearest is Ye 2016 adipose-niche chemoprotection in blast-crisis CML), and no translatable preclinical evidence was found titrating leukemia burden against graft-versus-leukemia or DLI efficacy, so the MRD-depth-before-second-graft rationale has no preclinical basis in this search. Reference check: 31 PMIDs verified live against NCBI ESummary for existence, first/last author, year and journal; 0 retraction publication types in the corpus efetch XML; 29 DOIs resolved against CrossRef with title match; Gandhi 1996 DOI added from CrossRef (PubMed carries none) and Miederer 2004 left null because no DOI exists in CrossRef or PubMed. Every included key_finding was written from the fetched abstract, not from search-result metadata. Not committed, not pushed.

notes: Question-scoped round 1 against question.json (CR-induction endpoint), not a targetable_features ranking. Rank 2 CLAG-GO NCT04050280: fit without evidence, carried by CLAG-M true CR 58% (66/118), CLAG over MEC 37.9% vs 23.8% true CR head-to-head, cladribine ara-CTP potentiation, and the n=2 paediatric extramedullary GO datum that is the only tissue-response evidence in the file. Rank 3 HAM-venetoclax (CRc 75%, 41/55, 35% prior allo) despite her venetoclax refractoriness, on BH3 re-priming and variable-not-absent chemosensitivity of BAX mutants. Rank 4 CLAG-M off protocol as the start-immediately option given peripheral blasts 58 to 82 percent, with concurrent thigh radiotherapy as adjunct. Not ranked and flagged in notes: lintuzumab-Ac225 + CLAG-M, the best mechanism fit in the dossier (composite CR/CRi 50% TP53-mutated, 38.5% prior venetoclax; alpha kill independent of cell cycle and p53; reverses venetoclax resistance in vivo) but not deliverable with NCT03441048 completed and NCT06802523 suspended; asked the board to make the expanded-access call anyway. Round 2 dissent flagged in advance against CPX-351 + venetoclax (true CR 15%, she falls in the 26% second-salvage/TP53-mutated split, tissue:plasma below 1). No preferences.json exists for this question-scoped case, so no toxicity_veto screen was runnable; harm screening done against ECOG 1, undocumented organ function and prior anthracycline exposure, all recorded as concerns. Not committed, not pushed.

Round 1 critic position, question-scoped to question.json (ELN 2022 true CR as the endpoint), not a targetable_features ranking. Five picks, no abstention: CPX-351+venetoclax (NCT03629171) rank 1 as the only prospective protocol reporting true CR (15%, 5/33) separately from CRc (39%) in a cohort containing prior-venetoclax (58%), prior-transplant (30%) and second-salvage-or-later (44%) patients; CLAG-M rank 2 (largest true-CR dataset, wholly unmatched population); post-allograft HMA-VEN rank 3 (closest population, composite-only endpoint); RELAX/HAM-VEN rank 4 (75% is CRc with no CR-only split anywhere, plus an unreconciled SAE denominator in the abstract); CLAG-GO rank 5 explicitly as an access route with zero published efficacy in the indication. Acceptance criteria assessed in notes: 1 not found, 2 not found as pre-registered (prior-allograft applicability), 3 lands for CLAG-M and CLAG-GO but not for CPX-351+venetoclax, 4 LANDS (Wilson intervals for true CR in populations containing her all overlap: CPX-VEN 6.7-30.9, Byrne 11.8-48.8, MIRROS control 11.4-24.7, Giles 10.3-15.7), 5 technically met and practically not (McNeil n=2 paediatric FDG-PET, no CR grading), 6 lands (lintuzumab-Ac225 completed, NCT06802523 suspended; flotetuzumab terminated with a non-ELN response definition; uproleselan phase 3 terminated), 7 met only by Price 2011, an unadjusted single-centre retrospective. Two arithmetic flags recorded: the Wierzbowska row prints 58% against a stated 66/118 (55.9%; 58% is 66/114 evaluable), and the RELAX abstract prints 15 SAEs in 14 (13%) patients where 14/55 is 25%. All 19 cited PMIDs/NCTs confirmed present in the case dossier; no full texts read beyond what the clinician/researcher rows record, and the RoB reading of RELAX is abstract-level only, stated as such in primary_concerns. Single atomic append to board/positions.jsonl; no other agent's rows touched. Not committed, not pushed.
